budget_justification.barrel_rump_chest: Four banded quarters of the body; the largest single mass (bones 17-20).
budget_justification.flank_bard_caparison: Scalloped bard panels and riding cloth per flank with rune jewels.
budget_justification.breastplate: Triple-point sea breastplate with gold blades and ocean gem.
budget_justification.neck_crest: Two neck bands, withers/mane crest fins and gold scale rows.
budget_justification.head_bard: Head tube, wrapping chamfron, chin medallion and ear fins.
budget_justification.saddle_girth: Rider saddle, cantle, pommel arc and girth on the native saddle band.
budget_justification.tail: Three armored tail links with gold rings and a bladed tip.
budget_justification.legs: Four barded legs: pauldrons, haunches, sleeves, shoes with fetlock crowns.
